Reading: Stream messages from Kafka topics into DuckDB tables. Multi-partition topics are scanned in parallel; the result is `(topic, partition, offset, key, message)` rows you decode in SQL.
Inspection: Inspect cluster shape and the loaded extension build — broker / topic / partition discovery via `tributary_metadata`, and the version stamp via `tributary_version`.
Schema Registry: Browse and change a Confluent-compatible Schema Registry — subjects, versions and schemas — and encode JSON values in its wire format. Credentials come from a `tributary_schema_registry` secret.
